body.query: What's the nationality of the customer who spent 548.4 in 2012/8/24?

raw_response.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.segment,
       c.currency,
       SUM(t.price) AS total_spent
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-24'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.segment, c.currency
HAVING SUM(t.price) = 548.4
